blast_db.mirbase_version_note: Built 2026-07-01 from mature.fa while miRBase CURRENT was 22.1 (48,885 mature = the 22.1 count). Kept on 22.1 for consistency with the family and overhang indexes; Release 23.1 (Sep 2026) is a separate upgrade.

note: Counts are classifier outputs with no ground truth — not confirmed false/true positives. 'no_tm_gate' = Ye12/Kwok90 rules + 10-nt anchor (with the Kwok orientation fix), i.e. the rules without the Tm gate; self/identical-sequence handling is the same in every setting. Hits identical in sequence to the target (other loci) are counted under identical_sequence_hits, not in any risk tier. '10_rt_step' = 10 °C SAFE margin plus the assay-level RT step with the design's RT primer (classifier v7, stem-loop group only); rt_discriminated_hits are hits the RT overhang rules out (ΔCq_RT ≥ 4.3), unresolvable_variants are shifted same-molecule entries (A3).
